question.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo kuhan krompir?

answer.en: Yes, dogs can eat cooked potatoes in moderation when they are served plain. Boiled or baked potato without butter, milk, salt or seasonings is fine in small amounts, as long as it is soft and not green.
answer.sl: Da, psi lahko v zmernih količinah jedo kuhan krompir, če je navaden. Kuhan ali pečen krompir brez masla, mleka, soli in začimb je v majhnih količinah v redu, če je mehak in ni zelen.

why.en: Plain cooked potato is fine for dogs, but it should be a treat, not a meal replacement, and only a small part of the diet. Too many helpings can lead to obesity, and lots of butter can trigger pancreatitis. Raw or green potatoes are unsafe and potentially toxic.
why.sl: Navaden kuhan krompir je za pse v redu, vendar naj bo priboljšek, ne nadomestek obroka, in le majhen del prehrane. Preveč porcij lahko vodi v debelost, veliko masla pa lahko sproži vnetje trebušne slinavke. Surov ali zelen krompir je nevaren in potencialno strupen.

what_to_do.en: Keep cooked potato as an occasional treat in small amounts. Never give raw potato or potato with green spots, and skip potato dishes made with butter, milk, salt or spices.
what_to_do.sl: Kuhan krompir ponudite le občasno in v majhnih količinah. Nikoli ne dajajte surovega krompirja ali krompirja z zelenimi lisami in se izogibajte krompirjevim jedem z maslom, mlekom, soljo ali začimbami.

serving.en: Plain boiled or baked, cooked until soft enough to mash so your dog doesn't choke. No butter, milk, salt or seasonings. Skins are okay if they are not green.
serving.sl: Navaden, kuhan ali pečen, dovolj mehak, da se ga da pretlačiti, da se pes ne zaduši. Brez masla, mleka, soli in začimb. Olupki so v redu, če niso zeleni.

child.en: Dogs can have a little plain cooked potato as a treat. A grown-up makes sure it is soft and has no butter or salt.
child.sl: Psi lahko za priboljšek dobijo malo navadnega kuhanega krompirja. Odrasli poskrbi, da je mehak ter brez masla in soli.

q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo pire krompir?

a.en: Only plain mashed potato, in small amounts, without butter, milk, salt or seasonings.
a.sl: Le navaden pretlačen krompir, v majhnih količinah, brez masla, mleka, soli in začimb.

q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo krompirjeve olupke?

a.en: Yes, potato skins are okay too, but not if they are green.
a.sl: Da, tudi krompirjevi olupki so v redu, vendar ne, če so zeleni.

q.en: Are French fries okay for dogs?

a.en: It's easy to have too much of a good thing with French fries, hash browns and other potato dishes. Potatoes should be treats, not meal replacements.
a.sl: Pri pomfriju, krompirjevih ploščicah in drugih krompirjevih jedeh hitro pretiravamo. Krompir naj bo priboljšek, ne nadomestek obroka.
